tasks.title: Target shift during the latency
tasks.statement: The target moves at **{v} m/s**, the camera → command latency is **{l} ms**. How many meters does the target move?

tasks.title: Computer's share of the energy
tasks.statement: The vehicle uses **{p} W** to hover and the computer uses **{c} W**. By what percentage does the computer shorten the hover time?
tasks.solution: t ∝ 1/P: the share is c/(p + c).
